message.content:
Explore the Nxeon platform codebase at /opt/nxeon (a Next.js + Prisma app) and map the existing admin "board" (kanban) feature so I can plan a major expansion. I need precise file paths and current structures. Report back:

1. **Schema**: In the Prisma schema (likely /opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma), the models Board, Column, Card, Attachment, Comment — their exact fields, relations, and any existing scoping (is a Board tied to anything? is there a concept of "app"/"product" like Nxeon vs Soul Pilates?). Quote the model definitions.

2. **App/product entities**: Search for how distinct "apps" or "products" are represented (e.g. Server, Service, a Product enum, project names like "Soul Pilates", "Nxeon", "studionexis"). Is there any existing entity a board could be bound to? List candidates with file:line.

3. **Server actions / API**: Where are the board's server actions or route handlers (create/update/move card, columns, attachments)? List the files and the exported function names.

4. **UI**: The /admin/board page and its components — list the files (page.tsx, kanban components, card modal, drag-and-drop library used e.g. dnd-kit/react-beautiful-dnd). Note how columns and cards are rendered, how DnD is wired, and the current layout container widths (the "dead space on the sides" the user mentioned — find the max-width/padding).

5. **Search**: Is there any board/card search currently? Where would card *content* (description/comments) search hook in?

6. **Docs/staging/prod/github integration points**: Search for existing integrations the app already has to (a) documentation (the /admin/docs feature + DOCUMENTATION.md), (b) staging/production deploy flows, (c) GitHub push. List the relevant modules/functions — the user wants board cards to be able to push work to these when moved through steps.

Be thorough but return a structured map (paths, model definitions, function names), not file dumps. This is for planning a 3-part expansion: (A) bind boards to apps, (B) big UI/UX beef-up (rename columns, drag-to-delete, better DnD, full-text search of card contents, denser layout, new features), (C) execution pipeline where moving a card through stages pushes to docs/staging/prod/github.

===deploy-staging.sh===
#!/bin/bash
# Deploy a ref (default: main from /opt/nxeon) to the staging environment.
# Usage: ./scripts/deploy-staging.sh [git-ref]
set -euo pipefail
REF="${1:-main}"
cd /opt/nxeon-staging

echo "==> Syncing staging to $REF"
git fetch origin
git reset --hard "origin/$REF"

echo "==> Installing dependencies"
npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -1

echo "==> Applying database schema"
npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss 2>&1 | tail -2
npm run db:seed 2>&1 | tail -2 || true

echo "==> Building"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4

# Web runs as the unprivileged 'nxeon' user. Only .next needs to be writable by
# it (Next cache); the rest stays root-owned and world-readable, and systemd
# injects .env as root. Do NOT chown the whole tree (breaks root git on .git).
echo "==> Fixing .next ownership for non-root web"
chown -R nxeon:nxeon /opt/nxeon-staging/.next 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 600 /opt/nxeon-staging/.env 2>/dev/null || true

echo "==> Restarting staging services"
systemctl restart nxeon-staging-web nxeon-staging-worker
sleep 5
systemctl is-active nxeon-staging-web nxeon-staging-worker
CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/)
echo "==> Staging responds: HTTP $CODE (http://$(grep ^PUBLIC_IP .env | cut -d= -f2):8080)"
[ "$CODE" = "200" ] || { echo "STAGING UNHEALTHY"; exit 1; }
echo "==> Staging deploy complete"
===promote-production.sh===
#!/bin/bash
# Promote the currently deployed staging commit to production.
# Verifies staging is healthy, fast-forwards nothing (prod working tree IS the repo),
# then rebuilds + restarts production services.
set -euo pipefail

STG_COMMIT=$(git -C /opt/nxeon-staging rev-parse HEAD)
PROD_COMMIT=$(git -C /opt/nxeon rev-parse HEAD)

echo "==> Staging is at:    $STG_COMMIT"
echo "==> Production is at: $PROD_COMMIT"

if ! systemctl is-active -q nxeon-staging-web; then
  echo "Refusing to promote: staging web service is not running." >&2
  exit 1
fi
CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/)
if [ "$CODE" != "200" ]; then
  echo "Refusing to promote: staging returns HTTP $CODE." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$STG_COMMIT" != "$PROD_COMMIT" ]; then
  echo "Note: production tree is at a different commit than staging."
  echo "Production deploys directly from /opt/nxeon's working tree (main)."
fi

cd /opt/nxeon
echo "==> Building production"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4
# Web runs as the unprivileged 'nxeon' user. Only .next needs to be writable by
# it (Next cache); the rest stays root-owned and world-readable, and systemd
# injects .env as root. Do NOT chown the whole tree (breaks root git on .git).
echo "==> Fixing .next ownership for non-root web"
chown -R nxeon:nxeon /opt/nxeon/.next 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 600 /opt/nxeon/.env 2>/dev/null || true
echo "==> Restarting production services"
systemctl restart nxeon-web nxeon-worker
sleep 5
systemctl is-active nxeon-web nxeon-worker
CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/)
echo "==> Production responds: HTTP $CODE"
[ "$CODE" = "200" ] || { echo "PRODUCTION UNHEALTHY — check journalctl -u nxeon-web"; exit 1; }
echo "==> Production promote complete"

- `CardType`: `IDEA | FEATURE | BUG | CHORE`
- `CardPriority`: `LOW | NORMAL | HIGH | URGENT`
- `AttachmentKind`: `IMAGE | VIDEO | FILE`

```prisma
model Board {                         // line 913
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  columns   BoardColumn[]
  cards     Card[]
}

model BoardColumn {                   // line 921
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  boardId  String
  board    Board   @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name     String
  position Int     @default(0)
  cards    Card[]
  @@index([boardId])
}

model Card {                          // line 932
  id          String           @id @default(cuid())
  boardId     String
  board       Board            @relation(...)
  columnId    String
  column      BoardColumn      @relation(...)
  title       String
  description String           @default("")   // markdown
  type        CardType         @default(FEATURE)
  priority    CardPriority     @default(NORMAL)
  labels      String[]         @default([])
  assignee    String?          // free-text ("me", "claude", a name)
  position    Int              @default(0)
  archivedAt  DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime         @updatedAt
  attachments CardAttachment[]
  comments    CardComment[]
  @@index([boardId]) @@index([columnId])
}

model CardAttachment {                // line 955
  id String @id; cardId String; card Card @relation(...)
  filename String; storedName String            // uuid+ext on disk
  mime String @default("application/octet-stream")
  sizeBytes Int @default(0); kind AttachmentKind @default(FILE)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()); @@index([cardId])
}

model CardComment {                   // line 969
  id String @id; cardId String; card Card @relation(...)
  authorName String @default(""); body String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()); @@index([cardId])
}
```

**Scoping — critical for Part A:** A `Board` has **no scoping field whatsoever**. It is not tied to any app/product/user/server. The only differentiator is `Board.name` (free text). Boards are distinguished purely by name; the code seeds a default board literally named `"Nxeon"` (`lib/actions-board.ts:39`) and the "new board" prompt suggests `"Soul Pilates"` (`BoardClient.tsx:42`). So today "which app" is an informal convention encoded in the board name only. Binding a board to an app = adding a new FK/enum column to `Board`.

## 2. App / product entities (candidates for board binding)

There is **no existing first-class "app" or "product" entity** and **no Product/App enum**. The only literal "Soul Pilates" reference is the placeholder prompt at `components/admin/BoardClient.tsx:42`. Candidates a board could bind to, with tradeoffs:

- **`Board.name` (current)** — the only present "app" signal, string only. `schema.prisma:915`.
- **`model Site`** (`schema.prisma:1607`) — website-builder sites: `name`, `slug` (globally-unique `*.nxeon` subdomain), `websiteId`, `status` DRAFT→PUBLISHED. Closest thing to a discrete "app/product you build."
- **`model Website`** (`schema.prisma:1478`) — provisioned sites on a VPS: `domain`, `docRoot`, `appSlug`, `status`. A deploy target.
- **`model Project`** (`schema.prisma:168`) — user-owned grouping of `servers` with `name`/`color`. Customer-facing, not an internal app.
- **`model Server`** (`schema.prisma:316`) — infra host; `ClaudeBuild` (the AI build pipeline) already binds to `serverId`.
- **`/admin/products`** (`app/admin/products/page.tsx`) — NOT an app registry; it's an ops view of billing add-ons (EmailSubscription, Volume). Misleading name; ignore for binding.

Bottom line: to bind boards to apps you will likely introduce a new lightweight `App`/`Product` model (or enum) since none exists, then FK it onto `Board`.

## 3. Server actions / API

**`lib/actions-board.ts`** (247 lines, `"use server"`) — all exported functions:
- Boards: `listBoards`, `createBoard`, `renameBoard`, `deleteBoard`, `getBoard` (+ internal `createBoardInternal`). Default columns constant: `["Ideas","Backlog","In progress","Review","Done"]` (line 11).
- Columns: `createColumn`, `renameColumn`, `deleteColumn` (refuses if non-archived cards remain).
- Cards: `createCard`, `updateCard`, `moveCard(cardId, toColumnId, toIndex)` (transactional reposition, line 179), `archiveCard`, `deleteCard` (hard delete + rm attachment dir), `getCard`.
- Comments/attachments: `addComment`, `deleteAttachment`.
- Exported types: `BoardSummary`, `CardSummary`, `ColumnData`, `BoardData`, `CardDetail`.
- All gated by `requireAdmin()` from `lib/auth`; every mutation calls `revalidatePath("/admin/board")`.

**`lib/board-shared.ts`** — non-server constant `BOARD_UPLOAD_DIR` (default `/opt/nxeon/board-uploads`), shared with the route handlers.

**Route handlers:**
- `app/api/board/attachments/route.ts` — `POST` upload (`?cardId=`); caps `MAX_VIDEO=300MB`, `MAX_OTHER=50MB`; writes to `BOARD_UPLOAD_DIR/board/<cardId>/`.
- `app/api/board/attachments/[id]/route.ts` — serves/deletes a stored attachment.

## 4. UI

- **Page:** `app/admin/board/page.tsx` — server component, `requireArea("platform")`, reads `?b=<boardId>`, calls `listBoards()`+`getBoard()`, renders `<BoardClient>`.
- **Main component:** `components/admin/BoardClient.tsx` (301 lines) — contains `BoardClient`, `Column`, `NewColumn`, and `CardModal` all in one file.
- **DnD:** **No library** — package.json has neither `dnd-kit` nor `react-beautiful-dnd`. It's hand-rolled **native HTML5 drag-and-drop**: a single `drag` state holds the dragged card id (`BoardClient.tsx:36`); `draggable` + `onDragStart={()=>onDragCard(card.id)}` on cards (line 123–124); `onDragOver`/`onDrop` on columns and cards (lines 112–126); `onDrop` does an optimistic local splice then calls `moveCard` (lines 48–60). No drag handle, no cross-column animation, no drag-to-delete, no column reordering (columns aren't draggable).
- **Card modal** (lines 167–301): title/type/priority/assignee inline edits, markdown description textarea (plain, no preview), attachment grid with image/video/file rendering + clipboard-paste-to-upload (`onPaste`, line 208), comments. No column/board move control inside the modal.
- **Layout / "dead space":** The outer container is `div.flex h-[calc(100vh-6.5rem)] flex-col gap-3` (line 66) — **no max-width, no explicit horizontal padding of its own**; it inherits width/padding from the admin shell wrapper (whatever wraps `/admin/*` pages). Columns are **fixed `w-72` (18rem)**, `shrink-0`, in a `flex ... overflow-x-auto` row (line 85). `NewColumn` is `w-64`. So density is controlled by the hardcoded `w-72` column width and the admin shell's own container padding/max-width — the side dead space almost certainly comes from the shared admin layout container, not this file. To densify: reduce `w-72`, and check the `/admin` layout wrapper for a `max-w-*`/`px-*`.

Also note **`components/admin/ImprovementsBoard.tsx`** is a *separate* board (the Improvements list at `/admin/improvements`) — not the kanban; don't confuse them. `PipelineBoard.tsx` (`components/customer/claude-code/`) is yet another read-only board that mirrors `ClaudeBuild.status`.

## 5. Search

**No board/card search exists today.** `lib/actions-board.ts` and `BoardClient.tsx` contain zero search logic (the only `search` hits are `searchParams` for board selection). For Part B full-text search over card *content*, the hook points are: `Card.title` + `Card.description` (line 938–939) and `CardComment.body` (line 974). A new server action in `lib/actions-board.ts` doing a Postgres query over those columns is the natural insertion point. For reference, the docs feature already implements a client-side section search pattern in `app/admin/docs/page.tsx` (builds a lowercased `search` field per section) — a model you can mirror.

## 6. Docs / staging / prod / GitHub integration points (Part C pipeline)

These already exist as **standalone shell/node scripts**, invoked manually from the shell — **not yet wired to any app action or UI**. Wiring a card-stage transition to trigger them is net-new, but the primitives are all here:

**Docs:**
- `app/admin/docs/page.tsx` — reads `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` off disk, renders via `lib/markdown` `renderMarkdown` + `components/admin/DocsViewer.tsx`.
- `scripts/publish-docs.mjs` — renders `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` → static HTML at `/var/www/nxeon-docs/index.html` (public docs site). Zero deps.
- Source of truth file: `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`.

**Staging / production deploy:**
- `scripts/deploy-staging.sh [git-ref]` — in `/opt/nxeon-staging`: `git fetch` + `reset --hard origin/<ref>`, `npm install`, `prisma db push`, `db:seed`, `npm run build`, restart `nxeon-staging-web`/`nxeon-staging-worker`, health-check port 8080.
- `scripts/promote-production.sh` — verifies staging healthy, rebuilds `/opt/nxeon`, restarts `nxeon-web`/`nxeon-worker`, health-checks port 80.
- systemd units in `deploy/` (`nxeon-*.service`/`.timer`).

**GitHub push:**
- `scripts/setup-github.sh <ssh-remote>` — one-time deploy-key setup + initial push.
- `.git/hooks/post-commit` — **auto-pushes every commit** to `origin main` if a remote exists (`git push origin main --quiet`, logs to `/var/log/nxeon-git-push.log`). So "push to GitHub" for a card = create a commit; the hook handles the push.

**Improvements pipeline (a working precedent for card→backend):**
- `scripts/write-improvement.ts` — CLI that inserts an `Improvement` row (`schema.prisma:1581`, status `PROPOSED→APPROVED→IN_PROGRESS→DONE`); called by `scripts/nightly-scan.ts`.
- `lib/actions-improvements.ts` — `setImprovementStatus`, `bulkSetStatus`, `setImprovementNote`; UI `components/admin/ImprovementsBoard.tsx`.

**AI execution surface (relevant if "push work" means running an agent):**
- `lib/actions-claude.ts` — `submitBuild`, `approveBuild`, `rejectBuild`, `listBuilds`, backed by `model ClaudeBuild` (`schema.prisma:1000`, status `QUEUED|PLANNING|AWAITING_APPROVAL|RUNNING|DONE|FAILED`). This is the existing pattern for stage-gated execution with approval — the closest template for a card-driven pipeline.
- No `lib/*` module currently shells out to the deploy/git scripts (`child_process`/`git push` grep in `lib/` returned nothing board- or deploy-related), so Part C needs a new server action (admin-gated, like the rest) that invokes these scripts, plus a way to map a column/stage transition in `moveCard` to the right script (docs-publish / deploy-staging / promote-production / commit-for-github).

### Planning implications (quick synthesis)
- **(A) Bind boards to apps:** no app entity exists — add one (new `App` model or enum) and a scalar/relation on `Board`; `Board.name` is the only current proxy. Migration is additive/low-risk.
- **(B) UI/UX:** everything is in one file (`BoardClient.tsx`) with hand-rolled HTML5 DnD and hardcoded `w-72` columns; renaming columns already works (`renameColumn`). Drag-to-delete, better DnD (consider adding `dnd-kit`), full-text search (new action over `title`/`description`/`CardComment.body`), and denser layout (shrink `w-72`, audit the `/admin` shell container padding/max-width) are all localized changes.
- **(C) Execution pipeline:** the deploy/docs/github primitives exist as scripts + a post-commit auto-push hook + the `ClaudeBuild` approval-gated execution model as a template; the missing piece is a server action that ties a card's stage transition (in `moveCard`) to invoking them.
